mapper.select: SELECT ta.id, ta.task_id, ta.algorithm_id, a.algorithm_name, ta.sample_interval, ta.validity_end, ta.event_id, e.event_name, ta.schedule_rules, ta.created_at, ta.updated_at FROM task_algorithm ta LEFT JOIN algorithm a ON ta.algorithm_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN event e ON ta.event_id = e.id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.id ASC

a.algorithm_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{algorithmName}, '%')

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO task_algorithm (task_id, algorithm_id, sample_interval, validity_end, event_id, schedule_rules, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.algorithmId}, #{item.sampleInterval}, #{item.validityEnd}, #{item.eventId}, #{item.scheduleRules, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{item.createdBy}, #{item.updatedBy}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM task_algorithm ta INNER JOIN task t ON ta.task_id = t.id WHERE ta.algorithm_id = #{algorithmId} AND t.task_status = 'running' AND t.deleted = 0
